verdict.rationale: Insomnia has no documented native monitors, scheduling, or alerting. The closest evidence is the Collection Runner plus Inso CLI, which is built to run in CI and returns exit codes that pass or fail the workflow. That makes it a CI-based workaround: scheduling and alerting would have to come from an external CI system. Missing for 10: native scheduled monitors, built-in alerting/notifications on failure, documented cron/scheduled CI recipes, independent corroboration.
